action: Choose exactly one of recipient A or recipient B for a supplemental potential donor, equal cost, whose viability succeeds with a fixed probability q independently of all existing donors. The action does not change other donor states and does not ensure actual recolonization.
fixed_premisses: No change to source→target movement capacity assumed except this potential additional donor
No redistribution of actual migrants or competition
Supplying additional donor prevents all-accessible-donors-unavailable event for protected receiver only when donor viable
No intervention effectiveness/cost is measured in ecology; this is an explicit hypothetical conservation decision
decision_criterion: maximize reduction of probability selected receiving island has no potentially viable accessible donor = q*P(original local cutset failure), with equal costs
predeclared_output: full minus and plus world results for every q and each action
optimal receiver A/B for each world and signed intervention regret of choosing the wrong receiver
same aggregate no-addition risk 1/4 across A+B
at q=1 either world optimal reduction 3/16 and suboptimal reduction 1/16, difference 1/8
at q=1/2 optimal reduction 3/32 and suboptimal 1/32, regret 1/16
the summary-only model sees identical features and cannot select the receiver; selecting a single recipient based only on summaries may regret 1/8 at q1
